name: Disaster Crew
storyline:
Take the Jobs Nobody Else Will

In a near future where robots have taken most of the good jobs, four friends decide to start their own construction company.
They are new to the business, but they have one surprisingly effective strategy: accepting jobs no ordinary crew would take.
Disaster Crew is a co-op adventure for up to four players. Explore dangerous worksites, gather materials, complete strange construction orders, and prepare for whatever the worksite throws at you.

Gather, Haul, and Build
Everything you need is somewhere out there.
Explore the worksite, gather what you need, and work together to complete the client’s order.

Expect the Unexpected
Every worksite has its own surprises, and no job goes exactly as planned.
Stay together, adapt when things go wrong, and see whether your crew can finish what it started.

Complete the contract, get paid, prepare for the next job, and see how far four friends can take their unlikely new construction business.

Strange jobs. Dangerous places. What’s the worst that could happen?
summary: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.
